name: Visme
tagline: Design presentations, infographics, and simple interactive assets from templates

pricing.basis: annual billing, per user per month

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.limits: Unlimited projects; 500 MB storage; 50 slides/project; 10 AI credits/month; 3-minute recordings; PPT import up to 10 slides; public/Visme-branded output.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: 1 GB storage; 200 AI credits/month; unlimited slides; JPG/PNG/PDF export; recordings up to 45 minutes.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: 10 GB storage; 500 AI credits/month; PPTX/HTML5/video/GIF exports; brand tools and analytics.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom pricing from 10 users; 25 GB storage/user and unlimited AI credits.

pricing.freeTierCaps: Unlimited projects, 500 MB storage, 50 slides/project, 10 AI credits/month, 3-minute recordings and PPT import up to 10 slides.
pricing.billingTerms: annual only for current self-serve paid plans; Enterprise is custom
pricing.hiddenCosts: Enterprise starts at 10 users. Free output is public and Visme-branded; downloadable formats and privacy require a paid plan.

verdictSummary: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Visme, design presentations, infographics, and simple interactive assets from templates. The hard boundary is template depth, stock assets, brand kit, collaboration, and analytics, plus editor polish, assets, collaboration, and distribution.
coreLoopDIY: Compose presentations, infographics, and simple interactive assets from reusable template blocks on a canvas, edit text and media, and export a polished SVG or PDF.
whatYouLose: template depth, stock assets, brand kit, collaboration, and analytics
moatNotes: editor polish, assets, collaboration, and distribution
ongoingBurden: canvas correctness, fonts, exports, templates, asset rights, multiplayer state, and accessibility
whyPeopleStillPay: People still pay for Visme because people pay for a vast ready-made design system and a collaboration surface that behaves predictably under deadline. The recurring cost buys canvas correctness, fonts, exports, templates, asset rights, multiplayer state, and accessibility, not just the visible interface.

priorArt.name: Penpot
priorArt.desc: Mature open-source collaborative design platform with SVG-native editing.

alternatives.name: Adobe Express Free
alternatives.desc: Good free presentations, visual reports, and animated assets, with fewer data widgets but fewer export games.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the Adobe Express desktop/mobile app.
facts.engines: Adobe Firefly models power the generative features.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads, libraries and brand assets live in Adobe's cloud; exports include image, PDF and video files.
facts.gapVsPaid: Adobe Express has fewer data widgets, interactive embeds and presentation-specific visualization controls than Visme.

alternatives.name: Canva Free
alternatives.desc: Presentations, infographics, charts, templates, and simple animation with usable free exports; interactive embeds are more limited.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install Canva's desktop/mobile app.
facts.engines: Canva AI and Magic Studio provide generative tools; Canva does not publish a complete provider/model map for the free editor.
facts.dataFormat: Designs, uploads, folders and brand assets live in Canva's cloud; users export common image, PDF, presentation and video formats.
facts.gapVsPaid: Canva Free is less capable for interactive embeds and data-rich presentation/report widgets than paid Visme.

alternatives.name: Desygner Free
alternatives.desc: Multipage documents, templates, charts, brand assets, and sharing for a small team; the interactive layer is basic.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the mobile app.
facts.engines: Desygner's terms identify OpenAI-backed AI features.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads, fonts and brand assets live in Desygner's cloud; designs export as image or PDF files.
facts.gapVsPaid: Desygner's interactivity and data-visualization layer is much more basic than Visme's.

alternatives.name: VistaCreate Starter
alternatives.desc: Strong for template presentations and marketing graphics, weaker for data-rich reports and interactive widgets.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser, or install the mobile app.
facts.dataFormat: Projects, uploads and the single Brand Kit live in VistaCreate's cloud; exports include image, GIF and video files.
facts.gapVsPaid: VistaCreate is weaker for data-heavy reports, interactive assets and structured presentations.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Visme Basic
rejectedAlternatives.desc: The free editor lets you build projects but locks downloads behind payment, leaving branded public links as the exit.

notes: Editorial comparison targets the Starter plan and a personal design canvas DIY substitute. Recheck price before merge.
prompt:
Build a personal replacement for Visme in an empty repository.
Use Next.js 15, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, IndexedDB, and SVG; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: compose presentations, infographics, and simple interactive assets from reusable template blocks on a canvas, edit text and media, and export a polished SVG or PDF.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command.
Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Create a fixed-size SVG canvas with zoom, pan, selection, alignment, and snapping.
Support text, rectangles, circles, images, groups, layers, and reusable components.
Add a small set of high-quality starter layouts relevant to the product category.
Implement undo, redo, autosave, and import or export of a portable project JSON file.
Export SVG and print-ready PDF without rasterizing text unnecessarily.
Keep all assets local and display missing-font warnings before export.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Add input validation, safe filenames, and graceful handling of unavailable APIs.
Write focused tests for the core transformation and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, data location, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Deliberately leave out real-time multiplayer editing.
Deliberately leave out a commercial stock-asset library.
Deliberately leave out enterprise brand controls and approval workflows.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
